chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man catches one takbirah or two takbirahs in the salat (prayer) over the deceased, then let him make up what remains consecutively.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَةَ: a single takbirah in the funeral prayer
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ: two takbirat already reached in the prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer, here the prayer over the deceased
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.فَلْيَقْضِ: let him make up or complete what was missed
key_terms.مُتَتَابِعًا: in immediate succession, one after another

ai.seo_question: If someone misses some of the takbirat in the funeral prayer, should he make them up?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat (prayer) over the deceased for one who joins after some of its takbirat have already passed. It instructs that whatever takbirat remain missed are to be made up in consecutive order.
